title: Nasopalatine canal and dental implant placement in the anterior maxilla: a scoping review of clinical studies
html: Implant placement in the anterior maxilla may be complicated by proximity to the nasopalatine canal (NPC), particularly following post-extraction ridge remodelling. The aim of this scoping review was to map reported management strategies when the NPC interferes with implant placement and synthesize associated clinical outcomes. A comprehensive search was conducted across Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and hand-searched sources up to December 31, 2025. Eligible studies included human clinical reports describing implant placement in proximity to, or involving manipulation of, the NPC.
